items.title: Energy Transition Today - Cleantech Innovation Fuels Economic Growth and Competitiveness
items.summary: Foresight Canada has announced the 2026 Foresight 50 Honorees, highlighting a group of high-growth cleantech companies that are driving the energy transition with their innovative solutions. These companies, selected by an independent panel of climate investors, have collectively raised over USD $2.4 billion and are recognized for their investibility, leadership strength, and environmental impact. The honorees are transforming traditional industries and enhancing global competitiveness in...

items.title: NRG Soars 10% on $4 Billion Gas Plant Sale and $3 Billion Buyback Plan: “Unlocking Substantial Value”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysNRG Energy jumped 10% after agreeing to sell six gas plants to LS Power for $4 billion and raising its 2026-27 buyback plan to $3 billion. Buying back a stock this cheap is a smart use of the cash, though half goes to debt.

items.title: Vistra Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Cash Flow Plans & Demand Risks
items.summary: VST raises its 2026 outlook and projects stronger cash flow per share through 2030, backed by Cogentrix, power contracts and buybacks despite demand risks.

items.title: Data-Center Moratoriums? They Aren’t Showing Up in Constellation Energy’s Guidance.
items.summary: Constellation Energy raises full-year earnings guidance even as the U.S midterm elections have made some on Wall Street concerned the data-center buildout could stall.

items.title: Vistra and Constellation Both Fell Sharply After the Election. One Has Far More Exposure to Texas.
items.summary: The two power producers both face tough near-term challenges.

items.title: Vistra (VST) Stock Looks Reasonable As Its Five Year Run Continues
items.summary: Vistra Corp. has seen its share price swing sharply in recent years, and the question now is whether the earnings behind the business are strong enough to support where the stock trades today. With investors weighing both a long multi year run and more recent share price weakness, Vistra’s current valuation has become a live debate. items.title: Mistral CEO Pushes Back: Energy Is “Not the Bottleneck” for AI Compute. Here’s What Is.
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMistral CEO Arthur Mensch says energy is about 10% of AI compute’s cost and won’t be the bottleneck until 2029 or 2030. Mensch was talking about Europe, but Vistra’s CEO sees Texas power prices getting back on track on a similar 2029-2030 timeline.

items.title: Shortage of Turbines Drives Market for Second-Hand Market for AI Data Centers
items.summary: New gas turbines now take years to arrive, so AI data center developers are hunting for used machines and buying entire power plants. Five stocks sit on opposite sides of that scramble, and one of them is selling at a premium.
